name: kairoku
description: The road from idea to shipped: capture → spec → plan → Jira (TDD scaffold) → wave-parallel epic execution with honest Jira status and real PRs → QA → preview gate. Station agents, protocol skills, and workflows, wired to the Kairoku app and Atlassian.

jira_project_key.title: Jira project key
jira_project_key.description: The Jira project the delivery loop runs in, e.g. KAIR. Agents create nothing outside it.

confluence_space_key.title: Confluence space key
confluence_space_key.description: The space holding Planning/, Releases/, Sprints/ and QA/, e.g. KA.

atlassian_site.title: Atlassian site URL
atlassian_site.description: Your Atlassian Cloud site, e.g. https://acme.atlassian.net. Used by the bin/kairoku-jira sprint helper.

atlassian_email.title: Atlassian account email
atlassian_email.description: Email for the Atlassian API token. Only used by bin/kairoku-jira for sprint and board operations the MCP server does not expose.

atlassian_api_token.title: Atlassian API token
atlassian_api_token.description: Create at id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. Without it, sprint start/close stays a manual step and everything else still works.

kairoku_url.title: Kairoku app URL
kairoku_url.description: Base URL of your Kairoku deployment, e.g. https://kairoku.vercel.app. Leave blank to run without the app.

kairoku_token.title: Kairoku MCP token (headless only)
kairoku_token.description: Leave blank. Interactive sessions sign in through the browser with /mcp → Authenticate; the plugin sends no Authorization header, because a header the server rejects makes Claude Code report the connection failed instead of offering sign-in. This is only for headless runs, which have no browser and must supply the token to their own config.

kairoku_project_slug.title: Kairoku project slug
kairoku_project_slug.description: Which Kairoku project this repository builds. Agents default their reads and progress notes to it.

test_command.title: Test command
test_command.description: How this repository runs its test suite.

check_command.title: Lint + build command
check_command.description: The gate every story must pass before its commit.
check_command.default: bun run lint && bun run build

default_branch.title: Default branch
default_branch.description: Branch that epic pull requests target.
